SELECTED_INDEX: 10
CONFIDENCE: 0.63
EXPLANATION: The spectrum shows a clear OH/NH stretch (broad band at 3330 cm⁻¹), strong aliphatic C–H stretches (2840, 2945 cm⁻¹), a nitro-group symmetric stretch (1370 cm⁻¹), nitro wag/rock (814 cm⁻¹) and the C–N(NO₂) stretch (539 cm⁻¹). Peaks at 1100–1133 cm⁻¹ are consistent with C–O stretches of alcohols. Among the candidates, only molecule 10 (CCC(CO)(CO)[N+](=O)[O-]) simultaneously contains OH groups (explaining 3330 and 1100–1130 cm⁻¹) and a NO₂ group (explaining 1370, 814, 539 cm⁻¹) together with aliphatic chains (explaining the CH stretches). No other candidate has both OH and NO₂ functionalities.
